scope: Observation only: user-visible behavior, state flow, coroutine/Flow seams, platform capabilities, parity risks, and testable work packages in the frozen Telnyx Meet Android sample. No migration code is implemented by this task.

screens.name: Splash
behavior: Launcher activity; immediately starts ManageRoomActivity and finishes (no interactive UI).
Launcher registered in app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml.

screens.name: ManageRoomActivity (single-activity host)
behavior: Single FragmentContainer host; installs Hilt DefaultFragmentFactory before super.onCreate (custom constructor injection for fragments).
Starts Bugsnag unless BuildConfig.IS_APP_TESTING; Bugsnag API key hardcoded in app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml.
Wires Navigator.navController to the nav host controller; exposes setActionBarTitle used by fragments.
Nav graph start destination is joinRoomFragment; destinations: roomListFragment, roomCreateFragment, roomFragment, roomParticipantsFragment, roomChatFragment, sharingFullScreenFragment.

screens.name: JoinRoomFragment (start destination)
behavior: Room UUID field prefilled from BuildConfig.DEFAULT_ROOM (sourced from local.properties ROOM_ID in app/build.gradle buildTypes).
Participant name field defaults to R.string.dummy_android_participant_name ('Android Participant'); empty name shows R.string.provide_participant_name_error.
Camera toggle binds a CameraX front-camera preview (ProcessCameraProvider) into previewLoginView; placeholder swap on toggle.
Mic toggle only flips the icon and records micInitialState for the meeting screen (no capture on this screen).
Join button: if permissions granted navigates to roomCreateFragment with roomId+roomName; otherwise re-requests permissions via RoomsViewModel.checkPermissions.
'See available rooms' navigates to roomListFragment passing participantName; back press finishes the activity.

screens.name: RoomListFragment (browse, create entry, delete)
behavior: Loads room list page 1 on view creation; request permission on view creation.
Infinite scroll appends next page when nearing list end (getMoreRooms).
Pull-to-refresh reloads page 1 and clears refreshing indicator.
Swipe-left delete with red background + UNDO snackbar ('<room> removed'); delete executes only after snackbar timeout; success shows 'Room was deleted' toast and refreshes the list.
Item click joins an existing room (routes to roomCreateFragment with roomId/roomName) when permissions are granted; otherwise re-requests permissions.
FAB opens create-room flow (routes to roomCreateFragment without roomId); empty participant name blocks navigation with field error.

screens.name: RoomCreateFragment (create room or join by ID)
behavior: Dual mode: join-by-ID (roomId arg) auto-creates token on resume and hides name fields; create mode shows room-name input with CREATE button.
CREATE: empty name shows R.string.empty_or_not_unique_error field error; valid name calls createNewRoom.
Success chain rendered to user: room id/name ('...'), then room token ('...'), then connect; CREATE button re-enabled when room connection is live.
Non-unique room name: toast 'Room wasn't created: <server message>' plus inline field error; button re-enabled.
Invalid room id (token creation fails): toast 'Invalid room ID' then navigates back to joinRoomFragment (launchSingleTop, popUpToInclusive).
Room joined: navigates to roomFragment carrying roomId, roomName, refreshToken, refreshTimer (seconds at 90% of token expiry).
onStop stops the roomCreated value to prevent duplicate navigation on screen return.

screens.name: RoomFragment (meeting surface)
behavior: Forces portrait orientation and shows room id in header; action bar title is the room name.
Participant tile grid: 2 columns, max 8 tiles, overflow counter FAB ('N more') for extra participants; tiles render WebRTC video via SurfaceViewRenderer sinks.

Options menu actions (app/src/main/res/menu/room_menu.xml): toggle camera, toggle mic, open chat, flip camera, blur background, virtual background, mic source, share/speaking view, view participants, network quality, report issue.
Camera/mic on-off publish or update the stream (PublishConfigHelper; video 256x256@30fps, audio enabled); icons reflect state; 'self' stream key plus track keys '000' (video) / '001' (audio).
Blur and virtual background are TelnyxVideoProcessing filters on the published camera stream; virtual background uses bundled app/src/main/assets/clouds.jpeg.
Mic source dialog selects audio output between Phone earpiece, Bluetooth, Loud speaker (SDK AudioDevice).
Main-view button cycles FULL_PARTICIPANTS -> MAIN_SHARE_VIEW_AND_PARTICIPANTS -> MAIN_SHARE_VIEW_ONLY (navigates to full-screen share).
Full-screen button toggles between main share view and full-screen share fragment.
Tap a tile (or the presentation surface) to open a live WebRTC stats bottom sheet refreshed every 2 seconds; audio/video toggle switches stats source; dismissing the sheet cancels polling.
Presentation stream: when any participant publishes a 'presentation' stream, it is subscribed (video only) and rendered in the main surface; view switches to share layout.

State machine: DISCONNECTING shows progress bar; DISCONNECTED hides it and navigates to joinRoomFragment; back press runs disconnect sequence (stop captures, disconnect, reset media states, cancel token-refresh job).
Kick: if the leaving participant is self with KICKED reason, shows 'You were kicked!' toast and runs disconnect sequence without calling disconnect twice.
Join/leave notices: 'X has joined' / 'X has left' admin messages are appended to the shared chat history when the participant can receive messages.
Token refresh: one-shot coroutine delays for refreshTimer seconds, refreshes token, recomputes timer (90% of new expiry) and restarts.
On stop/resume: current camera/mic states are stored and capture restarts after resume (SHOULD_RESTART_CAPTURE saved via onSaveInstanceState).

screens.name: SharingFullScreenFragment (immersive presentation view)
behavior: Forces landscape orientation and repeatedly re-enables immersive system bars every 4 seconds.
Renders the sharer's 'presentation' video track full-screen; re-binds surface on each participants emission while sharing.
Auto-exits (navigateBack) when the sharer leaves or presentation video is disabled; back press also removes surface, restores system UI, and pops.
Releases the renderer surface on destroy.

screens.name: RoomChatFragment (text chat)
behavior: Lists chat history from the shared viewmodel; new messages auto-scroll to bottom.
Recipient selection: multi-choice dialog over message-capable participants with OK/Clear buttons; message is sent only to selected participant ids.
Send button sends a TEXT message, clears input, hides keyboard (app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/ui/utilities/KeyboardExtensions.kt).
Delivery success appends the message labeled 'SELF'; delivery failure is only logged; received messages are appended labeled by sender participant id with current HH:mm timestamp.
Joined/left participants add to the chat roster and produce admin messages '<name> has joined/left'.
History is saved back to the viewmodel on destroy and cleared when returning to the join screen.

screens.name: ParticipantsFragment (roster)
behavior: Shows live participant roster; updates on join, leave, speaking, and stream-changed events.
Re-registers observers on every resume (observer set is rebuilt in onResume).

steps: SplashScreenActivity forwards to ManageRoomActivity (app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/ui/SplashScreenActivity.kt).
Nav graph start destination joinRoomFragment (app/src/main/res/navigation/navigation_main.xml).
JoinRoomFragment submit -> roomCreateFragment(roomId, roomName=roomId).

RoomCreateFragment resume -> createTokenForRoom (app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/ui/RoomsViewModel.kt) -> tokenCreated -> connectToRoom -> joinedRoom -> roomFragment(roomId, roomName, refreshToken, refreshTimer).
Token failure -> 'Invalid room ID' toast -> back to joinRoomFragment.
RoomListFragment FAB or JoinRoomFragment -> roomCreateFragment(participantName).
CREATE -> createNewRoom -> roomCreated -> createTokenForRoom -> tokenCreated -> connect -> roomFragment.
Duplicate name -> error event -> toast + field error.
JoinRoomFragment 'see available rooms' -> roomListFragment(participantName).
Pagination via scroll; swipe-to-refresh resets page 1.
Swipe-left delete -> UNDO snackbar -> on timeout DELETE rooms/{id} via app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/data/RoomService.kt -> toast + list refresh; UNDO restores the row without deleting.

RoomFragment menu toggles camera/mic (publish vs update), flip camera, blur / virtual background, audio output dialog, chat, participants, network quality, report issue (Bugsnag with SDK state file, room id/name, participant id, user description).
Participants emission with a 'presentation' stream -> subscribe video-only -> main surface render -> view switches to MAIN_SHARE_VIEW_AND_PARTICIPANTS.
Full-screen action -> sharingFullScreenFragment (landscape immersive).
Teardown when presentation disabled or sharer leaves: unsubscribe, restore full participant grid; full-screen fragment pops itself.
Tile click or presentation-surface click -> stats polling coroutine (2s loop) -> BottomSheetDialog with per-source fields (remote/local video/audio).
Toggle button in the sheet switches audio<->video source; dismiss cancels the job.
RoomFragment menu -> roomChatFragment.
Participants observer builds recipient roster; multi-select dialog filters recipients; send -> delivery events append messages; leave/join produce admin messages.
Back on RoomFragment -> disconnectSequence -> DISCONNECTING progress -> DISCONNECTED -> navigate to joinRoomFragment.
Self kicked (KICKED reason) -> disconnectSequence(wasKicked=true) skips disconnect() and cancels refresh job -> 'You were kicked!' toast.
JoinRoomFragment and RoomListFragment request runtime permissions on view creation via RoomsViewModel.checkPermissions (Dexter).
All granted -> permissionRequest=true gates join/browse navigation.
Any permission permanently denied -> toast 'Camera and Audio permissions are required to continue', permissionRequest=false.
Denied-but-not-permanent -> no event is emitted, so gating silently blocks navigation (observed gap; preserve or change deliberately with tests).

RoomFragment delay(refreshTimer) -> refreshTokenForRoom -> tokenRefreshed event -> recompute refreshTimer = 90% of token_expires_at -> restart counter (app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/ui/utilities/Utils.kt calculateTokenExpireTime).

seams.name: Retrofit Call + enqueue callbacks
seams.current_mechanism: RoomService returns retrofit2.Call<T>; RoomsViewModel.enqueue callbacks postValue to LiveData (createTokenForRoom, refreshTokenForRoom, createNewRoom, getRoomList, deleteRoom).
seams.target_seam: suspend repository functions returning parsed models or a sealed Result; errors (non-unique room name, invalid room id) become explicit UI states instead of ad-hoc errorBody Gson parsing; loading LiveData<Boolean> becomes StateFlow-backed UI state.

seams.name: One-off events via LiveData<Event<T>>
seams.current_mechanism: SDK Event wrapper (com.telnyx.video.sdk.Event) with getContentIfNotHandled consumed by 6 fragments: tokenCreated, tokenRefreshed, roomError, deleted, joined/leaving participant, message delivery success/failed, message received.
seams.target_seam: SharedFlow (replay 0, extraBufferCapacity >= 1) or Channel for one-off effects with explicit lifecycle-cancellation semantics; durable equivalents as StateFlow. Delivery-once guarantees must be testable.

seams.name: SDK Room LiveData observables
seams.current_mechanism: RoomsViewModel forwards ~13 LiveData getters from the SDK Room object (connection status, participants, state changes, joined/leaving participant, speaking participant, stream changed, text-room events, joined room).
seams.target_seam: Platform adapter layer converts SDK callbacks/LiveData into a shared meeting contract: StateFlow<MeetingState> for durable state (connection, participants, streams, chat, stats availability) and SharedFlow<MeetingEffect> for one-off events; SDK LiveData never crosses shared code.

seams.name: Unmanaged CoroutineScope in UI
seams.current_mechanism: CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.Main).launch refresh-token counter (RoomFragment.startCounter), media-restore delays (300ms, onResume + checkInitialMediaStatus), stats polling (Dispatchers.Default, 2s loop), full-screen enforcer (4s loop), adapter notifyDataSetChanged debounce (1s).
seams.target_seam: viewModelScope / lifecycleScope or Flow builders (ticker/polling flow with distinctUntilChanged and debounce) tied to lifecycle; cancellation on disconnect and screen exit preserved.

seams.name: WebRTC stats callback
seams.current_mechanism: getWebRTCStatsForStream(participantId, streamKey, RTCStatsCollectorCallback) bridges SDK to fragment; fragment parses RTCStatsReport via string contains + Gson.
seams.target_seam: suspend fun or Flow<StatsSnapshot> from the shared contract; kotlinx.serialization replaces Gson + string matching; polling loop owns cancellation.

seams.name: Permission request (Dexter listener)
seams.current_mechanism: checkPermissions uses Dexter MultiplePermissionsListener and publishes permissionRequest MutableLiveData<Boolean>; toast on permanent denial only.
seams.target_seam: Suspend/Flow permission API behind a capability interface; permission state as StateFlow<PermissionState>; permanent-denial and soft-denial outcomes explicit.

seams.name: CameraX ListenableFuture preview
seams.current_mechanism: ProcessCameraProvider.getInstance + addListener to bind front-camera Preview to viewLifecycleOwner; unbindAll on stop.
seams.target_seam: Suspend await bridge for provider acquisition in the Android adapter; shared UI expresses only 'local preview on/off' intent; iOS uses its own capture adapter.

seams.name: Adapter callback interfaces
seams.current_mechanism: ParticipantTileListener and ClickListener/BindableAdapter interfaces wired from fragments; notifyDataSetChanged-driven updates (with 1s delayed batch for tiles).
seams.target_seam: Shared UI intents as sealed event types consumed by screen state holders; list rendering replaced by shared Compose lists with the same visible outcomes (tile surface binding, overflow counter, UNDO snackbar, auto-scroll).

shared_state_contracts.name: Token & room lifecycle
shared_state_contracts.details: createTokenForRoom -> room instance creation (Room(context, roomId, roomToken, externalData, enableMessages)) -> connect -> joinedRoom; refresh token cycle with token_expires_at at 90% (app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/ui/utilities/Utils.kt). Endpoints in app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/data/RoomService.kt.

shared_state_contracts.name: Media initial/current state
shared_state_contracts.details: MediaOnStart enum (ENABLED/DISABLED) for micInitialState/cameraInitialState (set by join-screen toggles, consumed once) and current camera/mic state (survives stop/resume; saved to instance state via RoomFragment SHOULD_RESTART_CAPTURE).

shared_state_contracts.name: Connection & SDK state machine
shared_state_contracts.details: State{status, action}: Status DISCONNECTING/DISCONNECTED drives progress + navigation; StateAction.NETWORK_METRICS_REPORT triggers adapter refresh. Queue-based state consumption in fragments.

shared_state_contracts.name: Participants & streams
shared_state_contracts.details: Participant{participantId, id, externalUsername, canReceiveMessages, streams[{streamKey, videoEnabled, videoTrack}]}; stream keys 'self'/'000'/'001'/'presentation'; StreamConfig(audioEnabled, videoEnabled); leaving events carry (id, reason) with KICKED; speaking emits (Participant, ?).

shared_state_contracts.name: Chat
shared_state_contracts.details: Message{content(type, payload), recipients[]}; MessageUI{sender, fullMessage, date} (app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/ui/models/MessageUI.kt); delivery success/failed events; admin message factory; history stored in viewmodel field (mutable, shared, cleared on join screen).

shared_state_contracts.name: Stats
shared_state_contracts.details: StatsSource {LOCAL,REMOTE}x{AUDIO,VIDEO}; StreamStats subclasses rendered in RoomFragment.updateDialogInfo define the exact field set both platforms must reproduce (frameWidth/frameHeight/bytesReceived/packetsReceived/packetsLost/framesPerSecond/totalInterFrameDelay; jitter/audioLevel/totalAudioEnergy/totalSamplesDuration; packetsSent/bytesSent/headerBytesSent/nackCount; retransmittedPacketsSent/retransmittedBytesSent).

shared_state_contracts.name: Audio output routing
shared_state_contracts.details: AudioDevice {PHONE_EARPIECE, BLUETOOTH, LOUDSPEAKER} selection dialog with phone as default.

shared_state_contracts.name: Room browsing & pagination
shared_state_contracts.details: page/total_pages from RoomsListResponse.meta; append-vs-replace semantics keyed on mLastRetrievedPage > 1; room deletion by id.

android.capability: Runtime permissions (camera, mic, media/storage by API level)
Publish/update/subscribe audio+video streams with constraints and camera flip
Background blur and virtual background on published video
Live WebRTC stats (RTCStatsReport) for local/remote audio/video

evidence: app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml (FOREGROUND_SERVICE permission; no service implementation under app/src/main/java)

ios.reason: No iOS source set, no iosMain/iosApp, no Podfile or Info.plist exists; the only video SDK dependency is the Android AAR com.github.team-telnyx:telnyx-meet-android-sdk:0.3.1 via JitPack (app/build.gradle).
unknown_capabilities: iOS Telnyx video SDK availability and API surface
Background blur / virtual background on iOS
WebRTC stats API and stat field parity
Audio output routing options on iOS
iOS permission model (Info.plist purpose strings) and lifecycle mapping
ios.policy: Report unknowns honestly; per benchmark/kmp-fast-vm-test/mission-brief.json excluded_scope, inventing unsupported iOS SDK capabilities is prohibited. Each unknown must be resolved by evidence (SDK docs, spike, or explicit capability gate) before shared UI assumes support; disabled-with-honest-UI is the default.

parity_risks.risk: org.webrtc.SurfaceViewRenderer is Android-only; shared Compose UI needs platform video renderers while preserving sink lifecycle (attach on presentation start, release on leave/destroy).
Media restore across config changes relies on onSaveInstanceState + ad-hoc 300ms delays; shared UI must reproduce restore semantics without Android instance state.
Orientation and immersive enforcement (portrait meeting, landscape share, 4s system-UI re-enforce loop) use Android activity APIs that have no shared equivalent.
SDK Room is constructed with an Android Context inside the viewmodel; shared contracts must own a platform-free meeting engine while adapters hold the context.
Non-unique room-name errors are parsed from errorBody string with Gson and read nameNotUnique[0] (null-unsafe); a typed error contract is needed to keep the toast/field-error behavior testable.
Stats parsing depends on RTCStatsReport.toString() containing 'mediaType: "video"' fragments; field extraction differs by platform and must be locked by contract tests.
handleStateChange duplicates the DISCONNECTED branch (two when-blocks, second wrapped in try/catch with a currentDestination guard); navigation duplication must be deduplicated intentionally.
Kick path cancels jobs but does not call disconnect(); ordering with the SDK's own DISCONNECTED navigation must be preserved to avoid double navigation or leaked captures.
Global loading flag races across concurrent calls (last postValue wins) and is toggled by every request; per-call state or a request counter is needed.
Chat roster and message history live in one mutable list shared by all fragments; re-observing on resume can duplicate recipient entries and history ownership is implicit.
Soft-denied permissions emit no result, silently blocking navigation; intentional-decision needed (keep or make explicit) with matching tests on both platforms.
Full-screen toggle discards its ViewMode expressions (currentViewMode is not updated), so returning from full-screen retains the previous layout mode; preserve or fix deliberately with tests.
Remote audio stats request uses the 'self' stream key for non-self participants; stats routing relies on SDK behavior that may not exist identically on iOS.

Credential hygiene: local.properties (API_KEY/ROOM_ID placeholders) is tracked in git and Bugsnag API key is committed in the manifest; migration must move these to untracked configuration per the mission gates.
Baseline Gradle build cannot resolve legacy WebRTC/libyuv artifacts (benchmark README); behavior parity tests must not depend on the broken legacy build path.

work_packages.title: Room list, pagination, and swipe-delete behavior
work_packages.behavior: List replaces on page 1 and appends on later pages; pull-to-refresh resets to page 1; swipe-left delete fires DELETE only after UNDO snackbar dismissal; success toast and refresh.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Repository/state-level tests with a fake paging API assert replace vs append per page, delete-after-timeout semantics, and UNDO rollback; no network required.

work_packages.title: Create-room success and duplicate-name error paths
work_packages.behavior: Valid name -> room created -> token requested -> connect -> navigate to meeting; duplicate name -> toast with server message + inline field error + re-enabled button.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Reducer/state-machine unit tests over success and typed failure responses verify the exact emitted states/effects and field errors.

work_packages.title: Join-by-ID and invalid-room fallback
work_packages.behavior: Token creation for a bad room id emits tokenCreationError -> 'Invalid room ID' toast and pops back to join; valid id auto-connects on resume.
work_packages.acceptance_test: State transitions from token failure to navigation are covered without Android UI (pure event streams).

work_packages.title: Permission gating matrix
work_packages.behavior: All granted gates navigation; permanently denied shows the required-continue toast; soft denial emits nothing today (decision documented).
work_packages.acceptance_test: Capability-interface tests simulate granted/soft-denied/permanent-denied and assert navigation gating and toasts; Android/iOS adapters tested separately.

work_packages.title: Camera/mic toggles and media-state restore
work_packages.behavior: Toggles publish or update streams; icons reflect state; join-screen initial media flags consumed once; restore after stop/resume uses saved camera state.
work_packages.acceptance_test: State-machine tests: publish-on-first-toggle vs update-on-subsequent, one-shot initial flags, restore path after backgrounding.

work_packages.title: Presentation share view transitions
work_packages.behavior: Presentation stream presence switches layouts and binds the main surface; stream end or sharer departure restores the grid; full-screen fragment opens/exits as specified.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Event-reduction tests over participants/stream-changed/leaving emissions assert every view-mode transition and unsubscribe call.

work_packages.title: Chat send, receive, delivery, and history
work_packages.behavior: Send only to selected recipients; delivery success appends SELF message; failure logged; received messages labeled by sender id; join/leave admin notices; history persists to viewmodel and clears on join screen.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Pure reducer tests for message bookkeeping plus recipient-selection logic; shared chat contract shared across platforms.

work_packages.title: WebRTC stats surfaces
work_packages.behavior: Tile/presentation clicks start 2-second polling for the correct source; bottom sheet renders the exact field set; sheet dismissal cancels polling; toggle switches audio/video.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Flow tests over synthetic stats snapshots assert source selection, polling cadence, and cancellation; rendering contract fixed by C6 field list.

work_packages.title: Token refresh timer semantics
work_packages.behavior: Refresh fires after refreshTimer seconds; new expiry recomputes timer at 90%; cycle restarts; disconnect cancels the job.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Virtual-time coroutine tests over the refresh cycle and cancellation.

work_packages.title: Disconnect and kick sequences
work_packages.behavior: Back press stops captures, disconnects, resets media states, cancels refresh; DISCONNECTING shows progress, DISCONNECTED navigates to join exactly once; kicked self shows toast and skips duplicate disconnect.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Ordered-event tests over state queue assert single navigation and capture teardown for both exit paths.

work_packages.title: Shared meeting contract surface (pre-migration definition)
work_packages.behavior: Define MeetingState/MeetingEffect equivalents for every observable currently exposed by RoomsViewModel and consumed by fragments (C1-C8), with buffered one-off delivery and lifecycle cancellation.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Contract test suite enumerates the observable set; shared tests must pass before any UI migration; architecture gate forbids LiveData/retrofit-callback/GlobalScope in common production code (benchmark/kmp-fast-vm-test/acceptance-gates.json).

work_packages.title: Capability matrix with honest iOS unknowns
work_packages.behavior: Publish capability table (android list above; iOS unknown entries pending evidence) linked to adapter tests; disabled capabilities shown honestly in UI.
work_packages.acceptance_test: Capability gate asserts every declared capability has adapter evidence or is explicitly listed as unavailable; no invented iOS behavior (mission-brief excluded_scope).

notes.only_expected_change: This file (benchmark/kmp-fast-vm-test/scouts/behavior.json). No app or benchmark input files are modified.
notes.sdk_boundary: com.telnyx.video.sdk.* types (Room, Event, Participant, Message, PublishConfigHelper, TelnyxVideoProcessing, State/Status, AudioDevice) originate from the JitPack AAR declared in app/build.gradle; their behavior is recorded as observed at the app-side call sites.
notes.event_wrapper: Event<T> is the SDK's one-off event wrapper consumed via getContentIfNotHandled across app/src/main/java/com/telnyx/meet/ui/.
notes.baseline_build: Legacy build resolution failure (WebRTC/libyuv) is pre-existing baseline evidence documented in benchmark/kmp-fast-vm-test/README.md and not caused by this task.
